# `publish` command

Publish the current project: a release archive for static hosting, an entry of an index.

```bash
fobis publish --help
```

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--archive` | TEXT |  | Write the release tarball and its manifest entry into DIR. |
| `--index` | TEXT |  | Add or refresh this project's entry in the index FILE. |
| `--version` | TEXT |  | Tag to publish (default: the latest tag of HEAD). |
| `--name` | TEXT |  | Package name (default: fobos [project] name). |
| `--source` | TEXT |  | Source URL written in the index (default: the origin remote). |

<!-- cli:end -->
